title: Jurassic World Park Map (2015)
description: The official in-universe visitor map of the Jurassic World theme park on Isla Nublar, as seen in Jurassic World (2015), designed in-story by graphic designer Ellen Lampl. Archived and documented on the Jurassic Park Wiki.

title: Isla Nublar
description: Overview and cartography of Isla Nublar, the primary island setting of Jurassic Park (1993) and Jurassic World (2015), located roughly 120 miles west of Costa Rica.

title: Jurassic Park / World Park Map (general)
description: Reference page collecting the various official park maps that have appeared across the Jurassic Park and Jurassic World films.

title: Jurassic-Pedia: Film Location Maps
description: Jurassic-Pedia is a long-running fan-run encyclopedia of the franchise; this category collects fan-researched and reconstructed maps of filming and in-universe locations.

title: Jurassic World Orlando Map (fan concept)
description: A fan-made recreation/concept map by artist JoshuaDunlop imagining a Jurassic World park map, hosted on DeviantArt.
